raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The region join is an inner join on customer_id, and about 363 POSTED transactions carry lowercase customer IDs (for example 'c00180' in batch 14) that do not match the uppercase keys in raw_customers, so they are silently dropped (4630 - 4267 = 363). Normalizing customer_id to uppercase and trimmed in silver_transactions restores the join keys without changing any column or the row set.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, upper(trim(customer_id)) AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
